caption: The drawing shows a wooden chair with a high back and armrests, depicted in a three-quarter view. The chair is brown in color with visible wood grain texture. The backrest features a scalloped top edge and two turned posts extending above the seat. The armrests are curved and supported by turned vertical spindles. The legs of the chair are also turned, connected by horizontal stretchers on all four sides near the bottom. The seat is rectangular and flat. The entire chair is centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. There are no other objects in the drawing. Near the bottom right corner, there is a small handwritten signature that reads "V. Van Vech."
title: Sacristy chair
